details.description: Metric label uses a single static class 'text-gray-500' which has poor contrast in dark mode (labels become hard to read on dark backgrounds).
details.fix_explanation: Apply conditional text color depending on dark mode so labels are readable in both themes (e.g. text-gray-300 in dark, text-gray-500 in light).

details.description: Toggle button used 'focus:ring' without ring width/color and light mode did not explicitly set a border color, causing inconsistent focus styling and an overly-strong border in light mode.
details.fix_explanation: Add focus:ring-2 and focus:ring-offset-2 and explicit border colors for each theme; choose accessible focus ring colors per theme.
details.before: className={`mb-4 px-3 py-1 border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring ${darkMode ? 'bg-gray-700 text-white border-gray-600' : 'bg-white text-black'}`},
details.after: className={`px-3 py-1 border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 ${darkMode ? 'bg-gray-700 text-white border-gray-600 focus:ring-gray-500' : 'bg-white text-black border-gray-200 focus:ring-indigo-300'}`},

details.description: Dark mode preference isn't persisted - toggling dark mode resets on reload.
details.fix_explanation: Persist dark mode preference to localStorage (read on mount, save on change) so the user's choice remains across sessions.
details.after: useEffect/read and write to localStorage around darkMode so preference persists; toggle uses setDarkMode(s => !s)

details.description: No empty-state when metrics array is empty (after loading completes but there are no metrics).
details.fix_explanation: Add an explicit 'No metrics available' message when metrics.length === 0 and not loading. Also add a small 'Refresh' button to trigger a reload of metrics for better UX.
details.after: Handle three states: loading, empty (No metrics available), and metrics grid. Added Refresh button to header.

details.description: Using metric label alone as React key can lead to collisions if labels repeat.
details.fix_explanation: Use a stable unique key by combining label with index (e.g., `${m.label}-${i}`) to avoid potential key collisions.
